evals.name: eval-nuget-package
evals.prompt: I want to understand how JsonConvert.SerializeObject actually implements reference loop handling internally. The Newtonsoft.Json package should be at ~/.nuget/packages/newtonsoft.json/13.0.3/lib/netstandard2.0/Newtonsoft.Json.dll. Can you decompile it and show me the relevant method?
evals.expected_output: Agent runs `dnx ilspycmd` directly against the DLL path, without first running `which ilspycmd` or installing the tool globally.
